# Your Daily Briefing — Wednesday 11 November

Yesterday was a relatively quiet day — no structured training, 7,675 steps, and your body burned 2,471 kcal, which actually nudged above your 2,300 target intake. That's a small natural deficit working in your favour toward that 80-85kg goal. Nice passive progress!

Your recovery picture is decent but not exceptional. HRV sits at 92ms, just inside the lower edge of your 91-122ms baseline, and with only 6 hours sleep last night, your body hasn't fully restocked. Resting HR of 52bpm is solid though. If today has a hard session planned, consider dropping the intensity by 10-15% — an easy aerobic run rather than anything structured.

Prioritise sleep tonight — genuinely, that's your biggest lever right now. Aim for 7.5-8 hours. Also nail your 175g protein today; it supports recovery even on rest days.
